description: Shell script for testing 'git remote' functionality, including remote management, fetch/push configurations, pruning, set-head, renaming, and updating remotes in a test environment.

methods.name: setup_repository
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository with a main and side branch, commits, and prepares for remote testing.

methods.name: tokens_match
methods.description: Compares two token lists for equality after sorting and filtering.

methods.name: check_remote_track
methods.description: Checks if a remote is tracking the expected branch.

methods.name: check_tracking_branch
methods.description: Checks if a remote branch exists.

methods.name: get_url_test
methods.description: Tests 'git remote get-url' with various options.
